facts.text: Serve the snacks when Thumper teaches Bambi to eat the clover.

facts.text: Bambi, the clover down by the creek is the sweetest. Fill up now, we have a big day of hopping tomorrow.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as a character line, so it counts as a quote. Thumper never says this. His lines on the Moviemistakes page are the greens rhyme, 'Whatcha gonna call 'im?' and 'Bambi... Yep, I guess that'll do all right.' The rhyme is 'Eating greens is a special treat, it makes long ears and great big feet.'
facts.fix: Eating greens is a special treat. It makes long ears and great big feet.
